liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Reviewer praises an excellent closing section beginning around the 8:10 mark [12]
- **Brown-Eyed Women** (1 review): Reviewer especially liked Chimenti's soloing in this song, finding it better than earlier versions on the tour [12]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Sugaree truly epic [6]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer says the Terrapin sounds wonderful on this recording, and that the sound quality is fantastic [8]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums/Space struck the reviewer's group as overwhelming [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **New Minglewood Blues**: rare: 14 archived performances [17]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Black-Throated Wind, Let It Grow [17]

## The recordings

- **deadandco2015-11-20.at4041-bp4025.flac16f** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **deadandco2015-11-20.akg483.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 184 min; rated 4.36/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound outstanding, with depth, clarity and little noise, close to an official release [13]
- **deadandco2015-11-20.akg.ck1x**: source not stated; 17 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the CK1X recording sounds great from what they've heard so far [11]
- **dead2015-11-20**: source not stated; 16 songs; 178 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Drums [1]
- Reviewer stayed in the parking lot, which was cold; friends got miracled into the show; a bus of hippies kept them warm [9]
- During Terrapin, a man nearby told a story about history of a lady with a fan [13]
- Crowd noise was very loud when Bobby let Mayer sing a tune, per reviewer, who wants Mayer to sing more [16]
- Uploader had no taper ticket; Scottrade security supervisor escorted them to the section, and ScottT provided clamp space [3]
- No song had been played more than four times on the tour so far; Shakedown Street and Brown-Eyed Women were repeats [12]
- Notes list set one at about 70 minutes and set two at about 110 minutes [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandco2015-11-20.at4041-bp4025.flac16f**: taped by Chris Finn; transferred by Chris Finn; source: Source 1: Audio-Technica AT4041's (cards, NOS) > Tascam DR-680 (Busman mod) (80Hz HPF) + Source 2: Audio-Technica BP4025 (cards, X/Y) > Tascam DR-680 (Busman… [1]. Also: Post-production used Sound Forge and Audacity: resampled to 44.1 kHz, 16-bit dithered, normalized, with fades applied to tracks 01, 07, 08 and 18 [1]
- **deadandco2015-11-20.akg483.flac16**: taped by Scott T.; transferred by Scott T.; source: AKG 483> V2> DR-07 [2]. Also: Recorded with AKG 483 mics through V2 preamp to DR-07 at 24/48, then processed in SoundForge with L3 and r8brain [2]
- **deadandco2015-11-20.akg.ck1x**: taped by goodcooker; transferred by goodcooker; source: AKG CK1x > Naiant Tinybox > DR60d [3]. Also: AKG CK1X mics were pointed at the stacks [3]
- **dead2015-11-20**: Source is AKG 483 to V2 to DR-07 at 24/48, taped by Scott T. from the tapers section [4]
